content:
The execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in campaign margins and total annual margin calculations.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a major mismatch in campaign values: close(468.0, 7956.0) returned False. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because total_annual_margin_6_day_usd was -45894.84 instead of the expected -83406.84. While the environment setup and 3 tests passed, the core logic for cost-benefit totals and row-level campaign IDs requires re-evaluation of the underlying formulas.
